preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100.
The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes labeled between 1 and n.
The number of nodes in your subtree is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n for x_i in x_labels)
preconditions.description: Each node in your subtree is labeled between 1 and n.
The number of nodes in Li Chen's subtree is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= y_i <= n for y_i in y_labels)
preconditions.description: Each node in Li Chen's subtree is labeled between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output is either a label from your subtree or -1 if no common vertex exists.
If the output is not -1, it is a label from Li Chen's subtree.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value in x_labels and return_value in y_labels)
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it is a common vertex label in both subtrees.
